method: Official PDF outline segments and original cubic curves joined into filled contours; original SVG filled rectangles retained. Duplicate bitmap, export strokes and dimensions removed. No raster tracing or lettering redesign.
source_components: 22 lettering contours including 10 original cubic segments, plus 7 filled rectangles (six brand blocks and one lettering bar). Two open components are closed beneath existing overlapping bars; no visible outline introduced.
reversed: Only #122e3b becomes #ffffff; #c7c8ca and #636466 each retained exactly once. All geometry identical.
presentation: Adaptive desktop overlay; original on mobile, solid/scrolled header and light footer. No CSS filters, backing, border, shadow.
visual_comparison: Side-by-side enlarged source PNG / clean vector / reversed vector reviewed locally; original curved terminals retained.
